title: Brand overview
content: Aviva Beauty is an Indian skincare brand focused on self-care and well-being. Founded by Vanshika Chachra. Tagline themes: More than just beauty. One step away from #skincare goals. Products are mineral oil free, paraben free, vegan, and dermatologically tested. Standards messaging includes FDA, GMP, ISO, and CE. Website: avivabeauty.in. Support email: support@avivabeauty.in.

title: Daily Gentle Cleanser
content: Water-based face wash / daily gentle cleanser. Customers describe it as refreshing, cleans without making skin dry. Available in multiple sizes including 100ml. Category: Face Care.

title: Creme Skin Toner
content: Aviva Beauty creme skin toner for face care routines. Pair with cleanser for a simple everyday ritual. Category: Face Care.

title: Hydrating Body Lotion Roll-on
content: Hydrating body lotion in roll-on format. Customers say it is not sticky and feels lightweight. Category: Body Care.

title: Aqua Gel Sunscreen
content: Aqua gel sunscreen for everyday sun care. Category: Sun Care / Face Care.

title: Gift hampers and combos
content: Aviva offers gift hampers and combo sets such as special skincare gift hampers pairing toner + cleanser or sunscreen + cleanser.

content: Shop by category: Face Care and Body Care. Collection all-products lists bestsellers.

title: Safety
